samples.code:
// 6 from the code default, until an admin saves another value or the environment overrides it.
var length = await settings.GetAsync<long>("links.token-length", token);

// TokenLength, BaseUrl, Timeout and Enabled are filled from links.token-length, links.base-url, and so on.
var options = await settings.SectionAsync<LinkOptions>("links", token);

// Only links.token-length and links.base-url are Public; timeout, enabled and the secret token are left out.
var values = await settings.PublicAsync(ScopeChain.AppOnly, token);

// The next read of an app-wide value goes to the source again instead of the cache.
await settings.InvalidateAsync(Scope.App);

samples.output: Settings need a lower-case AppCode of 1 to 24 characters (letters, digits and dashes).

samples.code:
// Saved values go to this file; the folder is created on the first save.
services.AddOSSettingJson("data/settings.json");

// Needed only for a source that keeps its own table of keys; the JSON file ignores it.
await services.SyncOSSettingsAsync(token);
